subject: install of ggvis 0.3 from CRAN depends on github version of dplyr

messages.author: b85fee989abd6bce
messages.subject: install of ggvis 0.3 from CRAN depends on github version of dplyr
parts:
I just tried to install ggvis 0.3 from CRAN but got an error that my dplyr wasn't new enough, so I had to install the github version of dplyr, which I did (install_github("dplyr", "hadley")); now I can install ggvis.
R version 3.0.2 (2013-09-25)
Platform: x86_64-pc-linux-gnu (64-bit)

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: install of ggvis 0.3 from CRAN depends on github version of dplyr
parts:
Are you using an up-to-date mirror? ggvis 0.3 (actually, now it's 0.3.0.1) uses dplyr 0.2, which is on CRAN:
http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/dplyr/index.html

-Winston
